cards.name: Aipom
cards.text: As it did more and more with its tail, its hands became clumsy. It makes its nest high in the treetops.

attacks.name: Yank Out
attacks.text: Discard random cards from your opponent's hand until they have 5 cards in their hand.

attacks.name: Tail Smash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.name: Mismagius
cards.text: Feared for its wrath and the curses it spreads, this Pokémon will also, on a whim, cast spells that help people.

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Nonahex
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has exactly 9 damage counters on it, that Pokémon is Knocked Out.

cards.name: Sabrina & Brycen
cards.text: Search your deck for up to 2 basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.,When you play this card, you may discard 5 other cards from your hand. If you do, you may also search for up to 3 Pokémon of different types in this way.,You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Reshiram & Charizard-GX
cards.text: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Outrage
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Flare Strike
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Flare Strike during your next turn.

attacks.name: Double Blaze-GX
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra Fire Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), this attack does 100 more damage, and this attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Pikachu & Zekrom-GX
cards.text: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Full Blitz
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Lightning Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokemon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Tag Bolt-GX
attacks.text: If this Pokemon has at least 3 extra Lightning Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), this attack does 170 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.) (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)
